page_title: CRE 1-2 BOL | Cremonese v Bologna 05/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) sees a yellow card in the hand of Rosario Abisso. And as it's a second one this game, a red follows and Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is sent from the pitch.
90+6' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+5' Martin Payero (Cremonese) receives a yellow card.
90+4' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Rosario Abisso had no choice but to send Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) off. VAR seen to good effect there!

90+4' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Youssef Maleh (Cremonese), but referee Rosario Abisso must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+1' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Federico Ravaglia no chance!
90+1' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Cremonese, he's going to review using VAR.

90' Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Rosario Abisso stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Cremonese.
88' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 12:13.
85' Marco Giampaolo has decided to make a change. Romano Floriani (Cremonese) replaces Alessio Zerbin.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nikola Moro leaves the pitch and Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) comes on.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Joao Mario will be replaced by Nadir Zortea (Bologna).
81' Corner kicks – 2:3.
78' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) replacing Jonathan Rowe.
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) coming on for Simon Sohm.

77' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
75' Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) receives a yellow card.
74' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
71' Martin Payero (Cremonese) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
70' The total number of attempts is 5:12.
68' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

68' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
67' The Bologna players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
65' Santiago Castro (Bologna) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
64' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
64' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is penalised for holding. Rosario Abisso signals a set piece.
61' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Federico Bernardeschi as he is replaced by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
60' Cremonese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

60' Federico Ravaglia makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target. Cremonese will take a corner kick.
58' Simon Sohm (Bologna) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
56' Corner kick. Cremonese will have an opportunity.
55' 32:68 – the ratio of ball possession.
53' Morten Thorsby is being substituted because of an injury. Marco Giampaolo sends Martin Payero (Cremonese) on the pitch.
51' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
50' Bologna are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
48' Santiago Castro (Bologna) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marco Giampaolo gives a chance to David Okereke and Milan Djuric (Cremonese) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Marco Giampaolo decided to make a change. Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) is replaced by Warren Bondo.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) comes off for Morten Thorsby.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) was quite harsh and Rosario Abisso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
44' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 0:2.

42' Nikola Moro (Bologna) takes the free kick from just outside the box and attempts to convert it into a goal. He hits it magnificently and the keeper must be relieved to see the ball hit the bar and ricochet away.
41' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. It's a free kick to Bologna, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
39' Bologna keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
36' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Rosario Abisso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
34' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.

33' Santiago Castro (Bologna) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Emil Audero makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
32' Total attempts – 2:5.
30' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
28' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just over the bar.
26' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
24' Bologna hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
22' A crossfield pass from Joao Mario (Bologna) fails to find any of his teammates.
19' The percentage of ball possession is – 31:69.
16' 0 - 2 Juan Miranda provides Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
14' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
12' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Santiago Castro (Bologna), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
11' Santiago Castro (Bologna) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

9' Cremonese are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
7' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) brings an opponent down and Rosario Abisso interrupts the game.
5' The Bologna players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
3' 0 - 1 Wonderful movement! Joao Mario (Bologna) makes a good run to pick up a cross on the edge of the box and sends an accurate shot into the top left corner.

Bologna will kick-off.
